mapper.select: SELECT h.holding_id, h.account_id, h.stock_code, s.stock_name, h.quantity, h.avg_price, h.update_at FROM holding h JOIN stock s ON h.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE h.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY h.update_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO holding(account_id, stock_code, quantity, avg_price) VALUES(#{accountId}, #{stockCode}, #{quantity}, #{avgPrice})
